commits_data.title: Windows: Check for MSYS2 at runtime
commits_data.message:
Windows: Check for MSYS2 at runtime

Using the __MINGW64__ define is not correct because we also
need to detect if we are running in an MSYS2 environment. It
might be the case that the program in built using MinGW-w64
without MSYS2.

Also we need to check for this at runtime to allow the program
to be built using MSYS2 but packaged for distribution without
MSYS2.
